selection_reason: observable input/survey ID -> session data assignment -> security-sensitive context propagation

hypotheses.fit_reason: The survey ID from external input is directly used to set a session context that could allow unauthorized access to file management resources.
Assignment of FileManagerContext based on survey ID without proper access control checks may allow unauthorized users to access files they shouldn't.

hypotheses.cwe_name: Improper Link Resolution Before File Access ('Link Following')
hypotheses.fit_reason: The context propagation using survey ID could lead to improper link resolution if the ID is manipulated to point to unintended resources.
